name: inharmonic-vibraphone
style: dark ambient, instrumental, no tempo, free time. Lead: soft-mallet vibraphone and tuned glass bells, each bar a few cents off its neighbour so struck notes beat and wobble against each other, inharmonic overtones, dark muffled timbre, slow swelling attack, long open cathedral reverb that turns a tiny room into an empty hall. Sparse single notes with long silences between. Beneath them a low grinding noise bed, like a distant motor or bowed sheet metal, rises slowly and thickens into dense spectral fullness. Three times a lone bell is struck hard and rings out, each harder than the last. Ending: every bar struck at once as one clashing dissonant cluster, then left to decay into near silence. Lo-fi, intimate, unresolved, cold
exclude: drums, beat, percussion loop, vocals, choir, humming, guitar, orchestra, strings, piano, bright major, melody hook, synth pad, uplifting
